column1:
Showers or thundershowers are likely at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Mannar to Matara via Puttalam, Colombo and Galle during the evening or night.
Winds will be Easterly in direction. Wind speed will be (20-30) kmph.

The sea areas around the island will be slight.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
